items.t: Ensured that all of Michigan's 7.7 million registered voters were mailed an application and instructions to vote from home.
items.q: Secretary Benson ensured that all of the state's 7.7 million registered voters were mailed an application and instructions to safely vote from home.

items.t: Said she will continue working with the Attorney General and legislators to pass the remaining provisions of the BRITE Act to further improve Michigan's ethics and transparency laws.
items.q: I will proudly continue my work with Attorney General Nessel and our partners in the Legislature to pass the other provisions of the BRITE Act to further improve the ethics and transparency laws in our state.

record.t: Established a task force of students from across the state to advise on civic engagement (2019).
record.q: The task force, first established by Benson in 2019, brings together students from across the state who are passionate about civic engagement.

record.t: Served as Michigan's top election official for eight years.
record.q: Michigan's top election official for the past eight years will now work to keep the governor's office in Democratic Party hands

record.t: Issued a statement reaffirming Michigan's election process following a presidential address.

record.t: Appointed Benton Harbor mayor Marcus Muhammad to her 15-person gubernatorial transition team.

record.t: Was elected governor of Michigan, receiving 53.8% of the vote to John James's 44.5%.
